propositions: The code-review extension seam does not dynamically fan in project criteria into Pass 1 or resolve them through repository-aware routing in Pass 3, creating an incomplete integration point.
Project routing can describe a code-review criterion but eval/CLI resolution remains plan-review-biased and does not admit dynamic project prompts or the code-review solver.
A net-new project criterion must enforce four-phase boundaries without allowing Pass 1 to assess severity/disposition, Pass 2 to discover/decide, Pass 3 to depend on LLM, or Pass 4 to re-adjudicate.
The generic fan-in and routing repair must map logical `project.<name>` ids to validator-safe physical `code-review-project-<name>` ids without special-casing `project.review-phase-boundaries`.
Live dogfooding in Gerrit requires capturing positive-control and negative-probe evidence with attestable patchset SHAs, coverage fields, and final submission purged of phase-violating directives.
